hypotheses.justification: Split on a < b. In that case use the existing proof. Otherwise b ≤ a, and γd is identically zero: when p.1 ≤ a, use TransportPrimitive.radial_zero_of_le hγ.continuous hs; otherwise p.1 > b, so use radial_zero_of_gt hs. This includes b = a. Unfolding weightedSource, normalizeSource, physicalCompact and streamPotential then gives the zero potential, since the integrands vanish. Both reconstructed fields and their derivatives are zero, so the divergence is zero everywhere, including the axis (zero_div).
